evals.name: partial-issue-and-review-notes
evals.prompt: Prepare a PR note for a command retry fix that delivers only part of issue 42. The reviewer wants local test results in the description. Reply only; do not mutate GitHub.
evals.expected_output: A consumer-facing Fixed bullet with a partial reference, no test results in the release note, and a separate proposed reviewer comment.
assertions: Uses (part of #42), not (#42) or a closing keyword.
Keeps verification in a proposed PR comment, not the body.
Does not perform an external mutation without a request.

evals.name: major-human-merge
evals.prompt: We requested shipping this breaking public API change with major. Can you merge it now? Explain the next step only.
evals.expected_output: Names the breaking change, affected consumers and resulting version as facts to confirm; a human must explicitly confirm the major bump and perform the merge.
assertions: Does not treat a general ship request as major confirmation.
Says a human merges even after confirmation.
Does not use squash, rebase or another history rewrite.

evals.name: logical-commits-and-non-release
evals.prompt: We changed only CI scripts and docs. Please suggest a label and commit boundaries. The tree also has unrelated formatting edits; squash everything into a patch release? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Proposes workflow-supported no-release, separates unrelated edits, preserves history and requires the applicable checks.
assertions: Chooses no-release for no outward-facing change, subject to workflow support.
Uses specific staged files and coherent buildable commits.
Rejects squash/history rewrite and does not waive required checks.
